field_binding_on_absence.interpretation: All absent outputs match visible facts, chiefly the requested subject with the wrong field. This is consistent with insufficient subject-and-field binding; it does not establish the internal retrieval algorithm.

middle_vs_first.interpretation: Changing only record order changes the selected visible value on this fixed renderer; middle placement helps in every dependent world.

representation.interpretation: Wrapping numbers alone is insufficient: the requested quoted codes also require string types. Digit-selection diagnostics are not declared correctness.

revision_key_vs_payload.interpretation: On comparison-key conflict rows, 85 outputs match the greatest code value and 66 match the payload of the greatest revision. Forty-three outputs match revision numerals rather than code payloads. These observations support competing selection/return-field hypotheses, not a proven payload-comparison algorithm.
